_doc: AI-17 test fixture in the autopilots.json shape (05 s4.4, s6.8; needs content: AI-19 writes ap_tower into autopilots.json). One shared `ap_tower` entry read by every tower def: fire_cone_k = ap_dart gun.fire_cone_k (05 s6.2 fire cone), think_period_ticks 10 (05 s10), and the 05 s6.8 choice-point numbers written out (the defaults of TargetParams.for_tower): hysteresis 1.3, attacking x1.5 within 600 m for 5 s, hp gain 0.5, crowd x0.7 above 2 towers, GUARD x2, rank weights 100..20 (R0 C2-15), 8 candidates scored in full. Envelopes, priority, range and lock time are NOT here: towers.json and the weapon defs own them.
